notes.title: Good Kill! Early Access - V5 - New Features, Bug Fixes & Enhancements
notes.notes:
Attention, Gunners!
Get ready for another huge update! The battlefield just got better with fixes, new features, and exciting additions. Thanks to your continued feedback, we’re pushing the limits of what's possible. Here's what’s new in Version 5 for the Steam Winter Sale!
[h1]
New Additions & Enhancements
[/h1]

[b]Level Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Level 01: Foliage edited for better visuals.
[*] Level 02 - Stage 2: Fixed enemy reinforcement vehicles colliding, and vehicle road edits made to improve gameplay.
[*] Level 03: AI spawn issues fixed, AI spawners and kill zones edited, foliage adjustments for improved coverage.
[*] Level 06: Fixed RPG spawn issue before quest, rock AI cover fixed, and collision improvements in kill zones and spawn points.
[*] Level 07: Fixed AI nav mesh walking on water.
[*] Level 09 & 10: Various AI, foliage, and nav mesh adjustments for smoother gameplay.
[/list]

[b]Helicopter Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cayuse Box Shadows: Disabled for performance improvements.
[*] Tutorial Helicopter: Fixed main and tail rotor functionality, and sprint state issue after entering the helicopter.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Muffled Sound Fix: Fixed the remaining muffled sound effect when health is low.
[*] Tutorial Outro: Shortened for better pacing.
[*] M60 Sprint to Aim Bug: Fixed visual bug during transition.
[*] Gunner Sense: Range increased for better battlefield awareness.
[/list]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Secondary Weapon Added: The M79 grenade launcher is now available and selectable!
[*] Footstep Sounds: Realistic footstep sounds for different surfaces (wood, metal, sand, soil).
[/list]

[b]New Level Props:[/b]
[list]
[*] US Dock: Added to the US Airbase for more immersive environments.
[/list]


[b]Last Stand Maps Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] New last stand map added.
[/list]

[b]Other Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon Sway: Adjusted for better aiming control.
[*] DSHK & M60D Sounds: Reworked for improved audio fidelity.
[*] Sidearm Added: The Colt 1911 is now available to use by pressing 3.
[*] Head Bobbing Toggle: Added an option in the controls menu to toggle head bobbing during movement.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] AI Issues: Fixed AI stuck inside vehicles and collision issues with various objects.
[*] Helicopter Rotation: Fixed the bug where the helicopter would spin on its own.
[*] DSHK Bullet Traces: Tracers now more visible.
[/list]

With every update, Good Kill evolves into the ultimate battlefield experience. Your feedback is the backbone of Early Access, and we can’t thank you enough for your support.

Stay sharp, soldiers. The mission continues.

notes.title: Good Kill! Early Access - Get Ready for the Battlefield with Our New Update!
notes.notes:
Attention, Gunners!
We're excited to bring you another game-changing update for Good Kill! Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we've introduced enhancements and fixes to make your battlefield experience even more immersive. Here's what’s new:

[h1][b]New Additions & Improvements:
[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Ally AI Soldiers: All maps now feature friendly AI comrades fighting by your side!
[*] Mouse Sensitivity Fixes: Adjusted sensitivity issues for ADS, Cayuse, and doorgun controls.
[*] ADS Improvements: Weapon sway and wiggle are now disabled while aiming down sights.
[*] M60 Updates:
Added FOV adjustments.
More realistic mechanics.
Fixed medkit faulty animation cycles.
[*] Post-Processing: Enhanced visuals and post-process tweaks across all levels.
[*] Improved Ally Logic: Smarter allies for better battlefield tactics.
[*] Possible Explosive Target Markings in Seek Target Function: Detect explosives, ally AIs, and enemies using the renamed "Seek Target" ability (press V).
[*] Hit Register Sounds: Added body hit sounds for allies and enemies.
[*] Doorgun Enhancements: Camera shake added for the M60 doorgun.
[*] Bug Fixes:
Fixed Gaz66 crash in Level 3, Stage 4.
Resolved M14 ADS sticking on-screen issue.
Pilot sounds now pause correctly when the game is paused.
[*]UI Overhaul: Redesigned tutorial pop-up quest widgets for better guidance.
[*]Polished Animations:
Reworked single-shot M60 animations and muzzle flash location.
Improved M16A1, M14, and AK47 animations.
[*]Gameplay Adjustments:
Grenade self-damage in the Cayuse is now fixed.
Sparks VFX added when shooting Gaz66.
Sensitivity and movement speed decrease when entering ADS mode.
Sprint animation camera angles polished.
Level 1 difficulty balanced.
Added water impact VFX when shooting water.
[*]Collision Fixes: Various collision issues resolved.
[*]New Sounds:
Seek Target ability, medkit use, hero damage, and death sounds.
[*]VFX Optimization: Improved performance with optimized visual effects.
[*]Camera Shake: Added immersive camera shake when the hero takes damage.
[/list]

We’re in this together!
With every update, Good Kill becomes an even better battlefield experience. Keep your feedback coming, and thank you for being part of this journey!

[b]Stay sharp, soldiers. The mission continues.[/b]

notes.title: Good Kill! Early Access - New Update - Enhancing Your Battlefield Experience!
notes.notes:
Attention, Gunners!
We’re back with an exciting new update for Good Kill! As we continue to shape the game with your valuable feedback, here’s what’s new:

[b]New Additions:[/b]

[list]
[*] Ally Soldiers - Experience the battlefield with AI comrades fighting by your side.
[*] Weapon Equip & Unequip Animations - Added realistic animations when equipping and unequipping your weapons.
[*] Sprint Animations - New sprint animations for M16 Base, M16 Full, and M14 weapons.
[*] Gunner Sense - Detect allies and enemies on the battlefield with this feature (Press "V" to activate).
[*] Animation Polishing - Smoother, more realistic animations throughout.
[*] Shell Ejection - Enhanced realism with visible shell ejections during firing.
[*] Increased Player Height - Taller player perspective for a more immersive experience.
[*] M60D Heating/Cooling Function - M60D now includes a realistic heat-up and cooldown mechanic.
[*] All Levels Polished - Fixed tree clipping issues, adjusted enemy spawns, and implemented overall improvements.
[*] Hit Register Sounds - New audio feedback for hit registration.
[*] Weapon Ammo Refill Sound - Added a sound effect for reloading ammo.
[*] From improved visuals to enhanced realism, each update brings us closer to delivering the ultimate experience. Thank you for being a part of Good Kill’s journey in Early Access!
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Community Update #1 Napalm & Artillery
notes.notes:
Hey GI's,

We are excited to bring the immersive world of Vietnam War to you with Good Kill! We are committed to create rich experience absorbing you.

In the meantime, we are experimenting different explosions that will blow your mind - [b]Artillery[/b] and [b]Napalm[/b]!

[h2]Artillery Support[/h2]
Artillery refers to large-calibre firearms designed primarily to deliver munitions over long distances. These weapons are an integral part of modern warfare due to their ability to provide indirect fire support, which means that they can hit targets that are beyond the line of sight, such as enemy positions, fortifications or vehicles.
[previewyoutube=JfkcLItr-BY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Napalm[/h2]
Napalm is a flammable liquid that sticks to surfaces upon impact and burns intensely. They're used to set buildings, woods and enemy forces ablaze, creating havoc and denying access to an area. Its ability to generate intense heat and spread rapidly makes it a devastating weapon, often used to disrupt enemy operations and infrastructure.
[previewyoutube=Goe5jz8hj8k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Wait for more![/h2]
We will bring more "devastating" content to you. Follow us to stay updated!
